articles.summary: In the first instalment of the Bioelectronics series (What are Bioelectronics and Neuromodulation?), we covered the field and technology at a fairly high level. This time, we’ll explore what neuromodulation (predominantly device technology) is doing for healthcare today, the major players in the industry, and how it’s regulated.How is neuromodulation being used?Neuromodulation refers to any technology that acts directly upon nerves to achieve health benefits.
